text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, on the way to the training track...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Not yet!
I won't back down right from the start!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yeeeeees!!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...*pant*... *wheeze*...
*haaaah*..."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Good work, good work~!
That final stretch was tough, wasn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yup! There's this rare girl who wants me to be her mentor.
So I'm helping her out right now~

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I-It's not rare at all!
Seeing you run always looks like so, sooo much fun, Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Dominating the race from the front! And her form is so clean! So cool!
Watching her is just so inspiring... she's incredible!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Someday, I'll win a turf GⅠ as a front runner too—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah. If you've got the energy to get all excited, that means you're doing one more lap~

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You're gonna get results in the next mock race
and then challenge me in a GⅠ, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, that junior Umamusume was set to run
in a mock race. When Ines Fujin and I headed to the track—

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Gah, *pant*... *pant*... gh.
...Uuuuugh... Aaaahhh...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Underclassman...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The junior Umamusume gradually fell back.
The mock race result was... 9th place.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Good work.
You fought hard till the very end.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...S-Senpai.
I... I...!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...! Wait—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I search for the junior Umamusume who walked away alongside Ines Fujin.
Perhaps she noticed something as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...to the pained expression of my junior the entire time she tried to hold the lead on the turf track.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Found you, underclassman.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Senpaaai...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Hey. While you were running in front, you weren't having any fun at all, were you?

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...! Why are you—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I get it. After all, I'm an Umamusume
who has always believed in running more joyfully than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So it's fine, you know?
You just focus on perfecting your own fun running.
It seems admiring something and truly loving it are a bit different, after all.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
“Still... even after senpai went out of her way
to teach me the tricks of front-running...!”

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. Both of us had fun during that time!
Didn't we both get a wonderful experience that was
more than enough to make up for it?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I am me, and you are you, junior.
Only you can truly experience
your own "fun," you know?

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward. I heard news that a junior Umamusume
had pulled off an upset win from behind in a dirt mock race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: They say that back then, despite being covered in mud, the junior Umamusume wore a bright, wonderful smile.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Once our little junior makes her debut,
I wonder what kind of fun she'll find next~.
choice_data_list: What kind of fun do you want to find next?
What kind of fun do you want to find next?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh... You're passing it to me~?
Hmm... Let's see~...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I want to keep leading, leading,
and leading out in front. And win as many GⅠs as I can.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Because that's what makes me happy.
choice_data_list: Then I'll be there to support you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Yeah.
Nice to meetcha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beside Ines Fujin, I watch the other Umamusume
run on the track. Five minutes later,
we began our own practice as well.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Lots of fun times like right now!
Mom and Dad staying healthy,
and my little sisters chasing their dreams.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"And I'll shine even brighter than that sun over there.
Savoring tons of my very own kind of 'fun.'"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna shine intensely as myself,
so bright that no one can ever imitate me!"
choice_data_list: Then it's still too early for the sunset.
Then it's still too early for the sunset.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course!
My fun's gonna keep on going from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today as well, Ines Fujin dashed out
onto the track with boundless energy.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I want to run in tons of GⅠ races from now on!
And escape, escape, escape!
I want to keep running away from defeat and everything else!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep running at the very front the whole time!
Ahead of everyone else! And then—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to savor this miraculous moment to the fullest,
where your fun and my fun become one and the same."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I'm kind of wishing
that this kind of selfishness could go on forever.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
choice_data_list: Let's keep aiming for victory together.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...! Yeah, let's win.
Lots and lots more, from now on too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'll win, win, and keep on winning!
I won't let this fun dream come to an end!
